title: MCP Tool Contracts for 005 Agent Model & Effort Control

tools.name: configure_antigravity
tools.description: Inspect or change Google Antigravity model and reasoning effort for the current session. Supports tiers ('light' for quick lookups/trivial tasks, 'balanced' for routine reviews/planning, 'deep' for hard bugs/complex architectures/security), explicit models, or custom efforts ('low'|'medium'|'high'|'xhigh'|'max'). Actions: 'get' (view current), 'set' (apply new settings), 'reset' (restore startup defaults), 'list' (catalog). Claude Code may switch tiers autonomously based on task difficulty.

action.description: Action to perform. Default is 'get' (read current configuration and options without changing state).

tier.description: Preset tier: 'light' (Gemini Flash Low), 'balanced' (Gemini Flash Medium), 'deep' (Gemini Flash High).

model.description: Model family or variant identifier (e.g. 'gemini-3.8-flash', 'gemini-3.1-pro', 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (High)').

effort.description: Desired reasoning effort level. Auto-mapped to supported levels for the target model family.

tools.name: ask_antigravity
tools.description: Get an INDEPENDENT second opinion or general answer from Google Antigravity. Uses the session-configured model & effort by default (startup: Gemini 3.8 Flash High).

paths.description: Optional file/folder paths to read as context.

model.description: Per-call model override (does not change session default).

tools.name: review_antigravity
tools.description: Request a structured code review from Google Antigravity inspecting correctness, bugs, race conditions, security, and architecture. Uses the session-configured model & effort by default.

prompt.description: Specific code review instructions or focus areas.

tools.name: brainstorm_antigravity
tools.description: Architectural brainstorming and exploration with Google Antigravity. Explores alternative design patterns, trade-offs, and pros/cons. Uses session-configured model & effort by default.

tools.name: plan_antigravity
tools.description: Generate a step-by-step implementation plan or execution checklist using Google Antigravity. Uses session-configured model & effort by default.

prompt.description: The feature or refactor goal to break down.

tools.name: delegate_antigravity
tools.description: Hand a self-contained implementation task to Google Antigravity, which EDITS FILES inside cwd. Uses session-configured model & effort by default.

prompt.description: The task instructions and acceptance criteria.

cwd.description: Absolute path of repository to work in.

tools.name: configure_codex
tools.description: Inspect or change OpenAI Codex model and reasoning effort for the current session. Supports tiers ('light' for quick lookups/trivial tasks, 'balanced' for routine work, 'deep' for complex refactoring/architecture/security), explicit models, or custom efforts ('low'|'medium'|'high'|'xhigh'|'max'|'ultra'). Actions: 'get' (view current), 'set' (apply new settings), 'reset' (restore startup defaults), 'list' (catalog). Claude Code may switch tiers autonomously based on task difficulty.

action.description: Action to perform. Default is 'get' (read current configuration and options without changing state).

effort.description: Desired reasoning effort level. Auto-mapped to supported levels for the target model.

tools.name: ask_codex

tools.name: review_codex

prompt.description: The feature or refactoring goal to break down.
